body: Building a travel app in public: the honest version.

Atlaria is a 3D globe of everywhere you've been. Every trip, every photo, pinned to where it happened.
One repo for web and mobile: Next.js, a static export into Capacitor, Supabase, Vercel, Sentry and PostHog.
It crashed right after launch. Sentry showed me where. Fixed by Day 26.
And the build videos beat my advice clips: around 700 views each vs about 315.
Tools: nextjs.org · capacitorjs.com · supabase.com · vercel.com · sentry.io · posthog.com

Follow the build: weekly build logs with honest numbers, wins and things that broke.
Free weekly guide: Life With AI, link in bio.
